definition: The four core candidates below have dated, primary-source expectation-gap reviews. These are reported operating observations and product disclosures, not stock recommendations or evidence that an agentic tailwind is already monetized.

companies.mechanism: More action-oriented traffic, security inspections, and edge-compute demand could increase billable consumption if Akamai retains the workload.

evidence.label: Agent-traffic classification
evidence.value: AI fetchers and agents separated from training/search crawlers

companies.agenticRead: CIS growth and commitments support an AI-infrastructure capture hypothesis; more granular agent-traffic controls improve product fit and measurement. Management does not separately report agent-driven revenue, adoption, pricing, or ARR.
companies.counterpoint: Delivery and other cloud-applications revenue declined 6% YoY and non-GAAP operating margin was 25%, down five points. The 10-Q expects AI / cloud capacity investment to raise future capital and operating costs.

companies.mechanism: Agent retrieval, vector search, and observability workloads could lift cloud consumption and retention.
companies.agenticRead: Elastic Cloud is largely consumption-based and grew 20%; agentic Kubernetes investigations and MCP skills create a plausible usage path. Elastic does not disclose agent-specific revenue, usage, or pricing.
companies.counterpoint: Total gross margin fell to 74% from 77% as cloud hosting costs rose faster than subscription revenue. The live market snapshot has a different fiscal-year end from Elastic guidance, so it cannot yet support a guide-versus-consensus read.

companies.mechanism: More autonomous software can create more logs, traces, and AI-observability demand.
companies.agenticRead: Logs consumption, Autonomous SRE / Cloud SRE / Agent Building, and the proposed Arize acquisition create a plausible AI-observability capture path. None is disclosed as agent-specific ARR or revenue.
companies.counterpoint: Subscription gross margin declined to 85% from 86% as cloud hosting costs rose. Management expects the proposed Arize deal to dilute FY2027 non-GAAP operating margin, and the live market snapshot is not fiscal-year aligned with company guidance.

companies.mechanism: AI gateway, MCP gateway, and application-delivery controls may become a necessary part of enterprise agent infrastructure.
companies.agenticRead: F5's August AI Gateway update combines model access, MCP agent-to-tool governance, and guardrails at a potential enforcement point. This establishes product relevance, not commercial adoption or monetization.
companies.counterpoint: Q3 growth was led by systems; software grew 7% and services 3%. AI Gateway revenue, attach, customer count, and usage are unreported; the live snapshot uses a different fiscal-year end from F5 guidance.

companies.mechanism: Enterprise AI data transfer and policy enforcement could expand the security control plane around agent deployment.
Agents communicating with customers or counterparties could compound paid messaging and engagement events.
Machine and AI traffic reaching origin infrastructure may create incremental edge and delivery consumption.
Delegated authority and machine identities could create a new identity-management layer for agents.
